steps.sql:
SELECT CAST((julianday('now') - julianday(Player.birthday)) / 365.25 AS INT) AS age
FROM Player
INNER JOIN Player_Attributes
  ON Player.player_api_id = Player_Attributes.player_api_id
WHERE Player_Attributes.sprint_speed >= 97
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', Player_Attributes.date) AS INTEGER) >= 2013
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', Player_Attributes.date) AS INTEGER) <= 2015
